scenario: Math builtins per LEXP.3 — abs, sqrt, floor, ceil, trunc, sign. `abs` is global; the other five are `math`'s, imported bare ([LIMP.3.3.4]). v=4.0 is a perfect square and exact integer-valued float so all six comparisons are exact.
rules_ds:
from math import sqrt, floor, ceil, trunc, sign

schema T scope logical:
    v: Float key

rule r_abs:
    T t where abs(t.v) == 4.0
->
    log critical "abs"

rule r_sqrt:
    T t where sqrt(t.v) == 2.0
->
    log critical "sqrt"

rule r_floor:
    T t where floor(t.v) == 4
->
    log critical "floor"

rule r_ceil:
    T t where ceil(t.v) == 4
->
    log critical "ceil"

rule r_trunc:
    T t where trunc(t.v) == 4
->
    log critical "trunc"

rule r_sign:
    T t where sign(t.v) == 1
->
    log critical "sign"
